## [30 years of Quality International Education in Sofia, Bulgaria](https://zlatarskischool.org/the-school/)

School founded in 1995
**Zlatarski International School, Sofia** is the largest and most experienced International Baccalaureate (IB) School in Bulgaria, authorised as**the first IB WORLD SCHOOL** in the country in 2003. The School celebrates 30 years since its foundation.
Established in 1995 as an English language secondary school, the School is **accredited by the Ministry of Education, International Baccalaureate Organisation (IBO) and Cambridge International Education.** The School educates Bulgarian and international students aged 11-18 years old in the national programme and the international programmes Cambridge Secondary (5-7 grade), Checkpoint (8 grade), IGCSE (9 -10 grade) and IB Diploma Programme (11-12 grade).
Our graduates achieve outstanding IGCSE, IB and matura exam results and they gain places at **the world’s most selective universities and programmes** in the UK, the Netherlands, Bulgaria, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, the US, Switzerland and beyond.
[ ABOUT OUR SCHOOL ](https://zlatarskischool.org/the-school/)
![](https://zlatarskischool.org/)
WHY CHOOSE US
## Globally Recognised Education 
We are the most experienced International Baccalaureate (IB) and Cambridge IGCSE school in Bulgaria, providing a strong academic foundation for lifelong success. Our achievements in numbers:
  * **25 School graduating classes and over 1,400 students** who graduated from Zlatarski International School with excellent and very good results in the **state matriculation exams.**
  * **20 IB graduating classes in the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme with over 800 IB Diploma graduates** , 450 students with IB Diplomas and 350 students with IB Certificates.
  * **13 Cambridge IGCSE classes and over 600 secondary school students** with IGCSE certificates
  * **7 Cambridge Checkpoint classes and over 340 students** with Checkpoint certificates

## Our Educational Programme
Zlatarski International School offers motivated 11-18 year-old students a world class curriculum and stimulating opportunities, organized in the following stages: 
**Lower Secondary School: (Grades 5-7):** national programme, enriched by the Cambridge Lower Secondary programme 
**Middle School: (Grades 8-10):** national programme, enriched by the Cambridge Checkpoint and IGCSE programme
**Upper Secondary School: (Grades 11-12):** IB Diploma programme and/or the national programme 
**International students in Grades 5-12** can choose to follow only the international pathway
The school has built a reputation of academic rigour and its curriculum prepares students in various **academic pathways** – Languages, Humanities, Sciences, Mathematics and the Arts.
![](https://zlatarskischool.org/)
Our Strengths Beyond Academics
## Our School Community
With our dedicated teachers, individual attention and supportive school environment, **students build friendships for life**. Our **teaching team consists of motivated professionals,** many of whom hold doctoral degrees and have been educated at prestigious international universities. They not only impart academic knowledge but also play a key role in fostering values such as mutual respect, tolerance, and collaboration. In an atmosphere of trust and openness, students feel free to express themselves, share ideas, and learn from one another.

register at the school by submitting an application form for sitting the exam, signed by the student and the parent. In addition, a copy of the student’s results are submitted – first page and page with marks from term one. The School provides sample exam papers at registration. **Days of Open Doors:** Information meetings with candidates and their parents are taking place in the School auditorium. At the session prospective students are presented with information about the characteristics of studying at Zlatarski, the requirements from students and the schedule for applying to the school. Candidates and their parents have the chance to meet current teachers and students of Zlatarski School. **Admissions Exam:** The admissions exam lasts for 4 hours and is composed of the following: * English – based on Cambridge Advanced * Mathematics – problems based on 9 and 10 grade material * Bulgarian – commentary of an unknown text **Announcement of Results: I intake:** Ranking is based on the sum of the three components of the admissions exam + the average result from first term (grade 10). Candidates are ranking with status “approved “, “approved under condition”, “not approved”. **Meetings with the Admissions Committee: Individual Schedule** The School organises individual meetings with candidates to the IB programme and their parents. The purpose is to advise on candidates’ choice of subjects and levels and to assess the motivation of students. The candidate for the IB must share the values, mission and philosophy of the IB organisation; know the Regulations of Zlatarski School; pursue qualities, described in IB learner profile. The schedule for meetings is agreed in advance with the administration of the School. **Preliminary Enrollment** Admitted students confirm their place by submitting an application form, also signed by their parents, and pay a preliminary enrollment fee. Students indicate their preferred subjects and rank them according to their preferences. The School has the right to redirect a student to another subject from the same group in case groups in the chosen subject are full. **Enrollment:** Enrollment for the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme takes place with a signed Contract for Tuition and Annex, paid first installment and after familiarizing with the IB Regulations and the Regulations of Zlatarski School. **NB!** * Admission criteria – overall results, exam results, motivation, discipline and contribution to the school community. * Candidates are advised to strictly follow the admissions procedure. Places, which have not been confirmed are offered to other candidates. Outside the admissions deadlines, the school cannot guarantee the quoted tuition fee. * Tuition fees are determined with a decision of the Governing body and can be updated according to the estimated costs for the school. **Transferring from another IB School:** Students enrolled in the IB Diploma programme from schools all over the world can transfer to Zlatarski International School, if there are vacant places in the IB classes. Such students should contact the School to discuss choice of subjects and deadlines. International students are highly encouraged to apply to Zlatarski International School of Sofia. Currently, our student community comprises of Bulgarian students and international students from Australia, the Czech Republic, China, Damascus, Hungary, India, Israel, Korea, Russia, Serbia and Montenegro, Slovenia, Turkey and the United Kingdom.
Applications from students coming from international schools or other schools outside Bulgaria are reviewed on a rolling, case-by-case basis. Interested students and their parents should get in contact with us at **admissions@zlatarskischool.org ** in advance in order to ensure all conditions and requirements are met prior to their arrival in Sofia.  
**  
We are particularly encouraging applications from students who:**  
– are currently attenting International Schools abroad  
– are following any of the these programmes: International Baccalaureate (PYP, MYP, DP), Cambridge Lower Secondary, Pre-GCSE, IGCSE, A levels, AP  
– are internationally minded, mobile citizens  
– are interested in studying in an international environment in Sofia, combining the richness of Bulgarian culture with international experience
**Requirements for Admission**  
– Good academic performance as testified by the student’s academic transcripts from previous school/s attended  
– Demonstrated English language proficiency
**Entry tests**  
Applicants may be required to sit tests in English and Mathematics at Zlatarski International School of Sofia prior to admission in order for the school to establish the particular needs of such students. Students applying for the International Baccalaureate Diploma Program will normally be asked to sit the school’s IB entry exam.
**Transferring from an IB school abroad**  
Students who are at present studying at another IB world school and are interested in continuing their education at Zlatarski International School – the first and most experienced IB School in Bulgaria will be given priority under the school admission policy.
**Interested in taking the IB Bulgarian A1 Self Taught?**  
Students who are currently attending IB schools abroad have the opportunity to take the IB Bulgarian A1 as a Self-Taught subject at Zlatarski International School of Sofia. [**Learn more.**](http://www.zlatarskischool.org/international-baccalaureate/ib-bulgarian/)
